instruction: Find and navigate to the vehicle registration renewal page on the Virginia DMV website.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from Virginia DMV homepage to the vehicle registration renewal page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify correct URL navigation.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL, which is the exact state needed to verify navigation
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) correctly compares the actual URL vs expected URL using compare_urls utility
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction (navigate to vehicle registration renewal page)
Expected URL value is semantically correct and matches the instruction requirement (/vehicles/registration/renew)
No postconfig needed - URL state is directly accessible from browser without UI state dependencies
Metric correctly handles rule parameter: accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] directly as returned by get_rule
Data flow is correct: getter outputs URL string/dict → metric handles both formats → comparison uses appropriate URL matching logic
